content.json:
# Justin Verstijnen Microsoft Intune with Log Analytics monitoring
1. Select a **Log Analytics Workspace**
2. Select a **Time Range**

Both filters apply to all five queries.

parameters.name: Workspace
parameters.label: Log Analytics Workspace
parameters.query:
Resources
| where type =~ "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces"
| order by name asc
| project value = id, label = name, selected = row_number() == 1, group = resourceGroup

content.json:
## 5.1 Intune Device Inventory
A filtered inventory of Windows devices with compliance and encryption indicators.

content.query:
IntuneDevices
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| where OS =~ "Windows" and EncryptionStatusString !~ "Encrypted"
| extend Compliance = strcat(iff(CompliantState =~ "Compliant", "✅ ", "❌ "), CompliantState)
| extend Encryption = case(tostring(EncryptionStatusString) in~ ("True", "Encrypted"), "✅ Encrypted", tostring(EncryptionStatusString) =~ "False", "❌ Not Encrypted", strcat("❌ ", EncryptionStatusString))
| extend LastSeen = format_datetime(todatetime(LastContact), "dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm")
| project DeviceName, UPN, Manufacturer, Model, SerialNumber, ['Operating System'] = OSVersion, Encryption, Compliance, LastSeen
| order by DeviceName asc
content.noDataMessage: No data for the selected workspace and time range.

content.json:
## 5.2 Intune devices by platform
Device records per operating system, ordered by count.

content.query:
IntuneDevices
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| summarize DeviceCount = count() by Platform = tostring(OS)
| order by DeviceCount desc
content.noDataMessage: No data for the selected workspace and time range.

content.json:
## 5.3 Compliance overview by operating system
Compliance status by operating system (records without a platform are excluded).

content.query:
IntuneDeviceComplianceOrg
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| where isnotempty(OS)
| summarize Devices = count() by OS, ComplianceState
| extend Category = strcat(OS, " - ", ComplianceState)
| project Category, Devices
content.noDataMessage: No data for the selected workspace and time range.

content.json:
## 5.4 Administrator activities
Intune administrator actions within the selected time period.

content.query:
IntuneAuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| project TimeGenerated, Identity, OperationName, Category, ResultType, ResultDescription
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.noDataMessage: No data for the selected workspace and time range.

content.json:
## 5.5 Deleted Intune objects
Intune audit activities containing Delete within the selected time period.

content.query:
IntuneAuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| where OperationName contains "Delete"
| project TimeGenerated, Identity, OperationName, Category, ResultType, ResultDescription, Properties
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.noDataMessage: No data for the selected workspace and time range.
